# An exact shared outside-facet budget for a simplex cap menu

This is a rank-sensitive auxiliary bound for the earlier actual base-tilt quota. It is not a general-body theorem and does not establish a lattice payment. Its value is that outside facets of different simplex caps cannot each be charged the full source section independently.

## 1. Statement

Let \(D\) be a \(d\)-simplex, \(d\geq2\), with barycentric coordinates \(\lambda_0,\ldots,\lambda_d\). Let the selected cap planes be \(\lambda_j=c_j\), where
\[
0<c_j\leq\frac1{d+1}.
\]
Let \(K\subset D\) be a positive-volume convex body. Let \(J\) be any set of indices for which \(K\subset\{\lambda_j\leq c_j\}\), and write
\[
r_j=\frac{H_{d-1}(K\cap\{\lambda_j=c_j\})}
 {H_{d-1}(D\cap\{\lambda_j=c_j\})}.
\]
Zero-area contacts are allowed. Then
\[
\sum_{j\in J}r_j\leq
C_d:=2\left[1-\left(1-\frac1d\right)^{d-1}\right]<\frac43.
\tag{1}
\]
The constant is sharp, attained by truncating exactly two coordinates at \(1/(d+1)\). In \(d=1\), the corresponding bound is one: a positive interval cannot lie on both complementary sides of the two midpoint cuts.

## 2. Elementary negative dependence on a simplex section

Let \(U=(U_1,\ldots,U_d)\) be uniform on the standard probability simplex \(\sum U_i=1\). For distinct coordinate indices and thresholds \(a_i\in[0,1]\),
\[
\Pr(U_i\leq a_i\text{ for all selected }i)
\leq\prod_i\Pr(U_i\leq a_i).
\tag{2}
\]
To prove one factorization step, condition on \(U_1=t\). The remaining coordinates have the law \((1-t)V\), where \(V\) is uniform on the lower-dimensional probability simplex. Hence the conditional probability that a prescribed collection of them lies below their thresholds is nondecreasing in \(t\). Its covariance with the nonincreasing function \(1_{\{t\leq a_1\}}\) is nonpositive. The latter assertion follows by integrating
\((f(t)-f(s))(g(t)-g(s))\leq0\) over two independent copies. Thus the joint event probability is at most \(\Pr(U_1\leq a_1)\) times the unconditional probability of the remaining event. Iterating proves (2). Conditioning involves only the usual uniform-simplex density; the endpoints have zero measure.

The marginal formula is
\[
\Pr(U_i\leq a)=1-(1-a)^{d-1}.
\tag{3}
\]

## 3. Proof and sharpness of the budget

Fix \(j\in J\). On the section \(\lambda_j=c_j\), the remaining normalized barycentric coordinates are uniform \(U\) as above, and \(K\)'s section lies in all events
\[
U_i\leq c_i/(1-c_j)\leq1/d,\qquad i\in J\setminus\{j\}.
\]
With \(k=|J|\), (2)--(3) give \(r_j\leq\alpha_d^{k-1}\), where
\(\alpha_d=1-(1-1/d)^{d-1}\). Thus the sum is at most \(k\alpha_d^{k-1}\).

One has \(1/2\leq\alpha_d<2/3\). The lower bound follows from
\((1+1/(d-1))^{d-1}\geq2\); the upper bound follows from
\((1-1/d)^{d-1}>e^{-1}>1/3\). For \(k\geq2\), the sequence \(k\alpha_d^{k-1}\) is nonincreasing because its next-term ratio is at most \((3/2)\alpha_d<1\). Also its \(k=2\) value dominates its \(k=1\) value. This proves (1).

For \(K=D\cap\{\lambda_0\leq1/(d+1),\lambda_1\leq1/(d+1)\}\), both relevant facets are positive and each ratio is exactly \(\alpha_d\) by (3). The body has positive volume and there are no further imposed outside caps. Thus the constant in (1) is attained.

For equal thresholds and \(k\) imposed caps, the individual ratio also has the exact inclusion-exclusion expression
\[
r_j=\sum_{\ell=0}^{k-1}(-1)^\ell
\binom{k-1}{\ell}(1-\ell/d)_+^{d-1}
\]
for the maximal truncated body. No numerical optimization is used in the bound.

## 4. Incorporation into an actual source-width quota

Suppose an actual propagated simplex menu has the homothetic source envelope
\(K_z\subset y(z)+\ell(z)D\), with equality at every integer source in a hull \(B\), and each pointed cap is one of the planes above. Let \(s_j>0\) be the own pointed coarea of cap \(j\), including its actual continuous-normal divisor. Every source coarea is \(\ell(z)^{d-1}s_j\), and every outside coarea \(A_{j,z}/s_j\) is \(\ell(z)^{d-1}\) times the ratio in Section 1.

Choose a base direction \(v\) and source extrema \(a=\min_B v\cdot z\), \(b=\max_B v\cdot z\), with \(a<b\). Sum the exact two-source base-tilt inequalities, divided by \(s_j\), over all \(d+1\) menu caps. Dropping only nonnegative inside terms and extra proper-section terms yields
\[
(d+1)(b-a)\sum_{z\in B\cap\mathbb Z^n}\ell(z)^{d-1}
\leq C_d\sum_{z\in P}\ell(z)^{d-1}
\big[(a-v\cdot z)_++(v\cdot z-b)_+\big].
\tag{4}
\]
The improvement over independent per-cap bounds is the single factor \(C_d<4/3\) on the right rather than \(d+1\). The full unweakened inequality retains all actual proper sections and inside penalties.

Equation (4) is only a necessary geometric condition. Its right side is not bounded universally by source mass or by the number of parities in this note. The later positive-width smoothing has a different singleton-source structure, so (4) is not asserted to apply there by taking source intervals from the unsmoothed limit.
